Messages.Author: atomweaver
Messages.Body:
XZealot <xze...@cox.net> wrote in news:1178047098.866811.308470
@e65g2000hsc.googlegroups.com:

> Can Mata Hari use sanguine instruction on any non-Caitiff vampire?
>

Mata Hari
Clan: Ravnos (group 4)
Capacity: 7
Disciplines: CHI OBF aus for qui
Independent. Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may
play cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that
required sect and/or clan.

Sanguine Instruction
Type: Action
+1 stealth action. Requires a ready vampire.
Choose a Discipline this vampire has at superior. Put this card on a
ready vampire of the same clan as this acting vampire. The vampire with
this card gains one level of the chosen Discipline. The vampire's
capacity increases by 1: the vampire is one generation older. Cannot be
placed on a vampire with the superior version of the Discipline.

Nope. A Sanguine Instruction doesn't 'require' the particular clan of
the target ready vampire, it instead limits the choice of target to
vampires of the same clan as the acting vamp. Mata can only SI other
Ravnos.

DZ
AW
